children: The European Commission approved on Tuesday Dutch state aid of €9.5 billion ($10.5 billion) to support renewable electricity production from two offshore wind farms in the North Sea.
"The aid will be granted through a transparent and non-discriminatory bidding process," the Commission said in a statement.
The two wind farms would have a combined capacity of 2 GigaWatts and are expected to generate up to 7,441 GWh of renewable electricity per year.
